propositions: LLM gate operations (transition closed, review-plan, verify-completion) emit no progress indication between start and final verdict, causing supervisor watchdogs that treat silence as stall to kill healthy runs that exceed typical 600s timeout budgets
The longest phases in gate execution are silent even at DEBUG log level: 27s material-assembly prologue and 40s overlap-corpus retrieval are pure local compute with no instrumentation
An autonomous agent was killed mid-close by its harness after 600s of silence during a verify-completion gate call, leaving the epic and story stranded in-progress despite all code changes landed

ADR 0089 and test suite (test_no_total_runtime_timer_mechanism, test_slow_but_alive_server_completes) intentionally encode silence-tolerance and forbid total-runtime caps, classifying this as feature-request not defect
The absence of progress emission is deliberate design per ADR 0089 and docs/plan-review-gate.md, which acknowledge time-to-first-token can be minutes but lack outbound liveness mechanism
